scientific_integrity: One elementary analytic two-parameter theorem, with exact polynomial verifier; the self-review is not an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact rank-one orthogonal-input-support angular phase diagram is restricted to a positive corner-projection second summand and real phases. The unrestricted Frobenius counterexample and global dimension threshold were already given by Zhang Example 8.2 and are not claimed as original.
title: A sharp angular phase boundary for the Frobenius symmetric-modulus defect of orthogonal-column rank-one pairs
